items.name: APEC Leaders' Meeting
agenda: Trade and supply chains across the Asia-Pacific
why: Leaders of 21 Pacific Rim economies meet, covering most of world trade.
Often a venue for talks between rival leaders, such as those of the US and China.
Sets the tone on tariffs and supply chains in the region.

items.name: COP31 climate summit
why: Countries review their promises to cut emissions under the Paris Agreement.
Decides how much money flows to poorer countries to cope with climate change.
Outcomes shape energy policy, from coal to solar and wind.

items.name: G20 Leaders' Summit
why: G20 members produce most of the world's economic output.
Coordinates responses to shared problems such as debt in poorer countries.
Trade tensions between members shape what can be agreed.
